description: Plan A (Apple HIG 5 Lenses + Native Code Audit) is the default baseline. Plan C defect cases are registered here when real visual, spatial, or interaction-layering defects are encountered in practice.

active_cases.title: Single-Plane Flat Tiling & ShipSwift Spatial Signature Loss (SWWallet Flattened to VStack/ForEach)
active_cases.symptom: Agent treats the appearance-ledger component palette as a mandatory flat checklist, stacking 4+ sections (Hero + Donut + Duplicate Category Bars + Flattened Wallet List + Transactions) in one >1000pt ScrollView, and rewrites ShipSwift SWWallet from a ZStack 3D pocket stack into a flat VStack/ForEach list.
active_cases.fix_rule: Apply the 3-Axis × P0..P3 Priority Matrix (Display / Action / Display+Action): cap any single viewport or split-view pane at 2-3 visual groups, collapse non-active groups (Accordion / Segmented Lens / Sheet), merge reference hints into placeholders/subtitles, and preserve ShipSwift SWWallet ZStack + zIndex + offset(y:) pocket geometry.

active_cases.title: Duplicate Same-Source Data Representation (Donut Legend + Redundant Category Progress Bars)
active_cases.symptom: Rendering a Donut/Ring chart with a full category breakdown legend AND immediately stacking a second category progress-bar list bound to the exact same dataset in the same pane.
active_cases.fix_rule: Never render the same dataset twice in one viewport; fuse the chart with a compact 2-column Bento legend grid (tap tile -> filter detail list) OR use a Segmented Picker to toggle between Chart and Progress List.

active_cases.title: Unbounded Horizontal HStack/ForEach Overflow & Multi-Card Row Cramming on Compact Width
active_cases.symptom: Unbounded HStack { ForEach(...) } without ScrollView(.horizontal) or cramming 3+ multi-button interactive cards into a single compact HStack expands the parent VStack beyond the iPhone viewport width (393pt), clipping sibling headers and cards on both left and right edges.
active_cases.fix_rule: Wrap dynamic horizontal rails in ScrollView(.horizontal, showsIndicators: false), scope per-item progress rails to the active parent item, cap complex interactive cards at <= 2 per horizontal row on compact width (use 2 + 1 grid for unilateral L + R + Reps), and apply .containerRelativeFrame(.horizontal) on vertical ScrollView content roots.

active_cases.title: LazyStack Leaf Conditional Subview Leak & OnAppear Prefetch Invalidation (WWDC26-321)
active_cases.symptom: Placing a top-level 'if' inside LazyVStack/LazyHStack ForEach closures creates dynamic 0/1 subview counts per element, defeating frame-deadline prefetching and retaining offscreen views in memory; delaying @Observable/@State model allocation to .onAppear misses the pre-render prefetch window.
active_cases.fix_rule: Filter data in the collection or @Query(#Predicate) before ForEach so each item resolves 1:1 to a single root view; initialize lightweight @State/@Observable view models in init (paired with @Observable Macro lazy property tracking) and use .onScrollTargetVisibilityChange(idType:threshold:) for media visibility.

active_cases.title: Table Header-to-Cell Column Geometry Drift (Flex Header vs. Fixed-Width Centered Row)
active_cases.symptom: Table header HStack uses maxWidth: .infinity + .leading on a column while the corresponding data row HStack uses only fixed width + .center columns, causing the row HStack to be narrower than the container, center-drift inside the card, and misalign every cell beneath its header.
active_cases.fix_rule: Enforce a shared column geometry contract between Header and Row (identical fixed column widths, identical maxWidth: .infinity flex columns, identical per-column alignment, and 100% matching outer HStack spacing/padding, or use SwiftUI Grid / GridRow); never pair a maxWidth: .infinity header column with fixed-width-only data rows.

active_cases.title: Static HTML Raw YAML Frontmatter Leak Above Doctype
active_cases.symptom: Static .html files served with .nojekyll or direct HTTP start with --- layout: null ... --- YAML frontmatter, rendering raw metadata text across the top of the browser viewport.
active_cases.fix_rule: Every static HTML entry file must start with <!doctype html> on line 1; handle routing via directory structure (/route/index.html) rather than Jekyll frontmatter.

active_cases.title: Web Prose Decorative Emoji Heading & Box-in-Box Callout Clutter
active_cases.symptom: Long-form Web prose prefixes section headings with decorative Emojis (📌/❓/✅/🎬/🏷️) and wraps every Q&A or checklist in its own bordered card, creating wireframe clutter.
active_cases.fix_rule: Use quiet editorial typography: native blockquote (4px left accent bar) for TL;DR, standard h2/h3 + 1px hairline dividers for Q&A/checklists, zero nested .card cages inside .prose, and zero decorative heading Emojis.

active_cases.title: Web Prose Table Global white-space:nowrap Horizontal Overflow
active_cases.symptom: Applying white-space: nowrap to all .prose th, .prose td forces multi-column CJK prose tables onto single lines, overflowing 680px desktop cards and clipping 390px mobile viewports.
active_cases.fix_rule: Allow natural text wrapping on .prose td (white-space: normal; min-width: 96px) inside an overflow-x: auto table container, and restrict white-space: nowrap to .num, time, or short code columns.
active_cases.good_snippet:
.prose th { white-space: nowrap; }
.prose td { padding: 8px 10px; white-space: normal; min-width: 96px; }

archived_templates.title: macOS Fixed-Width NSPopover Frame-Before-Padding Clipping
archived_templates.symptom: Applying .frame(width: W).padding(P) inside NSPopover expands intrinsic content width to W+2P and clips trailing controls.
archived_templates.fix_rule: Apply .padding(P).frame(width: W) and verify pixelWidth == W * scale.

archived_templates.title: Dynamic Telemetry Readout Numeric Ellipsis (12…)
archived_templates.symptom: High-precision metrics truncate with ellipsis when paired with long labels.
archived_templates.fix_rule: Apply .monospacedDigit() and .layoutPriority(1) on numeric readouts; use ViewThatFits for unbounded titles.
